messages.content: What is the number of faculty lines in campus "Long Beach State University" in 2002?

db.faculty.aggregate([{"$match": {"Year": 2002}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "Campuses", "localField": "Campus", "foreignField": "Id", "as": "c"}}, {"$unwind": "$c"}, {"$match": {"c.Campus": "Long Beach State University"}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "Faculty": 1}}])
What is the 3 most common cloud cover rates in the region of zip code 94107?

db.weather.aggregate([{"$match": {"zip_code": 94107}}, {"$group": {"_id": "$cloud_cover", "count": {"$sum": 1}}}, {"$sort": {"count": -1}}, {"$limit": 3}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "cloud_cover": "$_id"}}])
Find the student first and last names and grade points of all enrollments.

db.Enrolled_in.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "Gradeconversion", "localField": "Grade", "foreignField": "lettergrade", "as": "g"}}, {"$unwind": "$g"}, {"$lookup": {"from": "Student", "localField": "StuID", "foreignField": "StuID", "as": "s"}}, {"$unwind": "$s"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "Fname": "$s.Fname", "LName": "$s.LName", "gradepoint": "$g.gradepoint"}}])
Find the distinct names of all races held between 2014 and 2017?
db.races.aggregate([{"$match": {"year": {"$gte": 2014, "$lte": 2017}}}, {"$group": {"_id": "$name"}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "name": "$_id"}}])
What is the first name of each student enrolled in class ACCT-211?

db.CLASS.aggregate([{"$match": {"CRS_CODE": "ACCT-211"}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "ENROLL", "localField": "CLASS_CODE", "foreignField": "CLASS_CODE", "as": "enroll"}}, {"$unwind": "$enroll"}, {"$lookup": {"from": "STUDENT", "localField": "enroll.STU_NUM", "foreignField": "STU_NUM", "as": "student"}}, {"$unwind": "$student"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "stu_fname": "$student.STU_FNAME"}}])
List the names of all music genres.
db.Genre.find({}, {"_id": 0, "Name": 1})
What is the total population and average surface area of countries in North America with a surface area bigger than 3000?

db.country.aggregate([{"$match": {"Continent": "North America", "SurfaceArea": {"$gt": 3000}}}, {"$group": {"_id": None, "total_population": {"$sum": "$Population"}, "avg_surface_area": {"$avg": "$SurfaceArea"}}}])
For each classroom with at least 2 classes, how many classes are offered?
db.CLASS.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": "$CLASS_ROOM", "count": {"$sum": 1}}}, {"$match": {"count": {"$gte": 2}}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "count": 1, "CLASS_ROOM": "$_id"}}])
List the first names of female students.
db.Student.find({"Sex": "F"}, {"_id": 0, "Fname": 1})
when is the hire date for those employees whose first name does not containing the letter M?
db.employees.find({"FIRST_NAME": {"$not": {"$regex": "M"}}}, {"_id": 0, "HIRE_DATE": 1})
What are the ids and durations of the trips with the top 3 durations?
db.trip.find({}, {"_id": 0, "id": 1, "duration": 1}).sort({"duration": -1}).limit(3)
How many games were played in city Atlanta in 2000?

db.home_game.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "park", "localField": "park_id", "foreignField": "park_id", "as": "p"}}, {"$unwind": "$p"}, {"$match": {"year": 2000, "p.city": "Atlanta"}}, {"$count": "count"}])
What are the cities whose population is between 160000 and 900000?
db.city.find({"Population": {"$gte": 160000, "$lte": 900000}}, {"_id": 0, "Name": 1})
Who is the instructor with the highest salary?
db.instructor.find({}, {"_id": 0, "name": 1}).sort({"salary": -1}).limit(1)
What are the ids of the trips that lasted the longest and how long did they last?
db.trip.find({}, {"_id": 0, "id": 1, "duration": 1}).sort({"duration": -1}).limit(3)
Who owns the youngest dog? Give me his or her last name.

db.Dogs.aggregate([{"$addFields": {"age_num": {"$toInt": "$age"}}}, {"$group": {"_id": None, "max_age": {"$max": "$age_num"}, "rows": {"$push": "$$ROOT"}}}, {"$unwind": "$rows"}, {"$match": {"$expr": {"$eq": ["$rows.age_num", "$max_age"]}}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "Owners", "localField": "rows.owner_id", "foreignField": "owner_id", "as": "o"}}, {"$unwind": "$o"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "last_name": "$o.last_name"}}])
How many countries have a republic as their form of government?
db.country.count_documents({"GovernmentForm": "Republic"})
List the name of all rooms sorted by their prices.
db.Rooms.aggregate([{"$sort": {"basePrice": 1}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "roomName": 1}}])
In which year did the least people enter hall of fame?
db.hall_of_fame.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": "$yearid", "count": {"$sum": 1}}}, {"$sort": {"count": 1}}, {"$limit": 1}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "yearid": "$_id"}}])
What is the least common media type in all tracks?

db.Track.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": "$MediaTypeId", "track_count": {"$sum": 1}}}, {"$sort": {"track_count": 1}}, {"$limit": 1}, {"$lookup": {"from": "MediaType", "localField": "_id", "foreignField": "MediaTypeId", "as": "mt"}}, {"$unwind": "$mt"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "Name": "$mt.Name"}}])
Find the number of dog pets that are raised by female students (with sex F).

db.Has_Pet.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "Student", "localField": "StuID", "foreignField": "StuID", "as": "student"}}, {"$unwind": "$student"}, {"$match": {"student.Sex": "F"}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "Pets", "localField": "PetID", "foreignField": "PetID", "as": "pet"}}, {"$unwind": "$pet"}, {"$match": {"pet.PetType": "dog"}}, {"$count": "count"}])
Return the cities with more than 3 airports in the United States.
db.airports.aggregate([{"$match": {"country": "United States"}}, {"$group": {"_id": "$city", "count": {"$sum": 1}}}, {"$match": {"count": {"$gt": 3}}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "city": "$_id"}}])
How many classes are professor whose last name is Graztevski has?

db.EMPLOYEE.aggregate([{"$match": {"EMP_LNAME": "Graztevski"}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "CLASS", "localField": "EMP_NUM", "foreignField": "PROF_NUM", "as": "class"}}, {"$unwind": "$class"}, {"$count": "count"}])
Return each apartment type code along with the maximum and minimum number of rooms among each type.

db.Apartments.aggregate([{"$addFields": {"room_count_num": {"$toDouble": "$room_count"}}}, {"$group": {"_id": "$apt_type_code", "max_room_count": {"$max": "$room_count_num"}, "min_room_count": {"$min": "$room_count_num"}}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "apt_type_code": "$_id", "max_room_count": 1, "min_room_count": 1}}])
What is the number of distinct cities the stations are located at?
db.station.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": "$city"}}, {"$count": "count"}])
How many official languages does Afghanistan have?

db.country.aggregate([{"$match": {"Name": "Afghanistan"}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "countrylanguage", "localField": "Code", "foreignField": "CountryCode", "as": "langs"}}, {"$unwind": "$langs"}, {"$match": {"langs.IsOfficial": "T"}}, {"$count": "official_language_count"}])
What is the name and address of the department with the most students?

db.STUDENT.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": "$DEPT_CODE", "count": {"$sum": 1}}}, {"$sort": {"count": -1}}, {"$limit": 1}, {"$lookup": {"from": "DEPARTMENT", "localField": "_id", "foreignField": "DEPT_CODE", "as": "d"}}, {"$unwind": "$d"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "DEPT_NAME": "$d.DEPT_NAME", "DEPT_ADDRESS": "$d.DEPT_ADDRESS"}}])
What are the total number of credits offered by each department?

db.COURSE.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "CLASS", "localField": "CRS_CODE", "foreignField": "CRS_CODE", "as": "cl"}}, {"$unwind": "$cl"}, {"$group": {"_id": "$DEPT_CODE", "total_credit": {"$sum": "$CRS_CREDIT"}}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "total_credit": 1, "DEPT_CODE": "$_id"}}])
Find the first names and last names of male (sex is M) faculties who live in building NEB.
db.Faculty.find({"Sex": "M", "Building": "NEB"}, {"_id": 0, "Fname": 1, "Lname": 1})
What are the full names, departments, cities, and state provinces for each employee?

db.employees.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "departments", "localField": "DEPARTMENT_ID", "foreignField": "DEPARTMENT_ID", "as": "dept"}}, {"$unwind": "$dept"}, {"$lookup": {"from": "locations", "localField": "dept.LOCATION_ID", "foreignField": "LOCATION_ID", "as": "loc"}}, {"$unwind": "$loc"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "FIRST_NAME": 1, "LAST_NAME": 1, "department_name": "$dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME", "city": "$loc.CITY", "state_province": "$loc.STATE_PROVINCE"}}])
What is the name of all tracks in the Rock genre?

db.genres.aggregate([{"$match": {"name": "Rock"}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "tracks", "localField": "id", "foreignField": "genre_id", "as": "trk"}}, {"$unwind": "$trk"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "name": "$trk.name"}}])
Which city has the most addresses? List the city name, number of addresses, and city id.

db.address.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": "$city_id", "count": {"$sum": 1}}}, {"$sort": {"count": -1}}, {"$limit": 1}, {"$lookup": {"from": "city", "localField": "_id", "foreignField": "city_id", "as": "c"}}, {"$unwind": "$c"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "city": "$c.city", "count": 1, "city_id": "$_id"}}])
What is the minimum salary in each department?
db.employees.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": "$DEPARTMENT_ID", "min_salary": {"$min": "$SALARY"}}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "min_salary": 1, "DEPARTMENT_ID": "$_id"}}])
What are the names of instructors who didn't teach?
db.instructor.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "teaches", "localField": "ID", "foreignField": "ID", "as": "t"}}, {"$match": {"t": {"$eq": []}}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "name": 1}}])
How many countries has more than 2 car makers ?

db.countries.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "car_makers", "let": {"cid": "$CountryId"}, "pipeline": [{"$addFields": {"CountryInt": {"$toInt": "$Country"}}}, {"$match": {"$expr": {"$eq": ["$CountryInt", "$$cid"]}}}], "as": "makers"}}, {"$match": {"$expr": {"$gt": [{"$size": "$makers"}, 2]}}}, {"$count": "count"}])
What is the airport code of the airport with the most flights?

db.airports.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "flights", "localField": "AirportCode", "foreignField": "DestAirport", "as": "as_dest"}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "flights", "localField": "AirportCode", "foreignField": "SourceAirport", "as": "as_source"}}, {"$addFields": {"flight_count": {"$add": [{"$size": "$as_dest"}, {"$size": "$as_source"}]}}}, {"$sort": {"flight_count": -1}}, {"$limit": 1}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "AirportCode": 1}}])
What are dates of birth of all the guests whose gender is "Male"?
db.Guests.find({"gender_code": "Male"}, {"_id": 0, "date_of_birth": 1})
Find the title of the course that is offered by more than one department.
db.course.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": "$title", "count": {"$sum": 1}}}, {"$match": {"count": {"$gt": 1}}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "title": "$_id"}}])
What is all the information about employees who have never had a job in the past?

db.employees.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "job_history", "localField": "EMPLOYEE_ID", "foreignField": "EMPLOYEE_ID", "as": "jh"}}, {"$match": {"jh": {"$eq": []}}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "jh": 0}}])
How many 'likes' relationships are there?
db.Likes.count_documents({})
Which buildings does "Emma" manage? Give me the short names of the buildings.
db.Apartment_Buildings.find({"building_manager": "Emma"}, {"_id": 0, "building_short_name": 1})
Find the name and building of the department with the highest budget.
db.department.find({}, {"_id": 0, "dept_name": 1, "building": 1}).sort({"budget": -1}).limit(1)
Find the year and semester when offers the largest number of courses.

db.section.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": {"semester": "$semester", "year": "$year"}, "count": {"$sum": 1}}}, {"$sort": {"count": -1}}, {"$limit": 1}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "semester": "$_id.semester", "year": "$_id.year"}}])
List the names of all distinct wines that are made of red color grape.

db.grapes.aggregate([{"$match": {"Color": "Red"}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "wine", "localField": "Grape", "foreignField": "Grape", "as": "w"}}, {"$unwind": "$w"}, {"$group": {"_id": "$w.Name"}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "Name": "$_id"}}, {"$sort": {"Name": 1}}])
How many credits does course CIS-220 have, and what its description?
db.COURSE.find({"CRS_CODE": "CIS-220"}, {"_id": 0, "CRS_CREDIT": 1, "CRS_DESCRIPTION": 1})
What is the first name of the student whose last name starts with the letter S and is taking ACCT-211?

db.STUDENT.aggregate([{"$match": {"STU_LNAME": {"$regex": "^S"}}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "ENROLL", "localField": "STU_NUM", "foreignField": "STU_NUM", "as": "e"}}, {"$unwind": "$e"}, {"$lookup": {"from": "CLASS", "localField": "e.CLASS_CODE", "foreignField": "CLASS_CODE", "as": "cl"}}, {"$unwind": "$cl"}, {"$match": {"cl.CRS_CODE": "ACCT-211"}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "STU_FNAME": 1}}])
List all model names produced by maker id 6.
db.model_list.json.find({"Maker": 6}, {"_id": 0, "Model": 1})
How many students are in each department?
db.student.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": "$dept_name", "count": {"$sum": 1}}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "count": 1, "dept_name": "$_id"}}])
Show countries where a singer above age 40 and a singer below 30 are from.

db.singer.aggregate([{"$facet": {"a": [{"$match": {"Age": {"$gt": 40}}}, {"$group": {"_id": "$Country"}}], "b": [{"$match": {"Age": {"$lt": 30}}}, {"$group": {"_id": "$Country"}}]}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "country": {"$setIntersection": ["$a._id", "$b._id"]}}}])
List all singer names in concerts in year 2014.

db.singer_in_concert.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "concert", "localField": "concert_ID", "foreignField": "concert_ID", "as": "concert"}}, {"$unwind": "$concert"}, {"$match": {"concert.Year": "2014"}}, {"$addFields": {"Singer_ID_int": {"$toInt": "$Singer_ID"}}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "singer", "localField": "Singer_ID_int", "foreignField": "Singer_ID", "as": "singer"}}, {"$unwind": "$singer"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "Name": "$singer.Name"}}, {"$sort": {"Name": 1}}])
What are the employee ids and job ids for employees who make less than the lowest earning employee with title MK_MAN?

db.employees.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "employees", "pipeline": [{"$match": {"JOB_ID": "MK_MAN"}}, {"$group": {"_id": None, "min_salary": {"$min": "$SALARY"}}}], "as": "ref"}}, {"$unwind": "$ref"}, {"$match": {"$expr": {"$lt": ["$SALARY", "$ref.min_salary"]}}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "EMPLOYEE_ID": 1, "JOB_ID": 1}}])
How many countries exist?
db.countries.count_documents({})
Find employee with ID and name of the country presently where (s)he is working.

db.employees.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "departments", "localField": "DEPARTMENT_ID", "foreignField": "DEPARTMENT_ID", "as": "dept"}}, {"$unwind": "$dept"}, {"$lookup": {"from": "locations", "localField": "dept.LOCATION_ID", "foreignField": "LOCATION_ID", "as": "loc"}}, {"$unwind": "$loc"}, {"$lookup": {"from": "countries", "localField": "loc.COUNTRY_ID", "foreignField": "COUNTRY_ID", "as": "country"}}, {"$unwind": "$country"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "EMPLOYEE_ID": 1, "COUNTRY_NAME": "$country.COUNTRY_NAME"}}])
Show me all grades that have at least 4 students.
db.Highschooler.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": "$grade", "count": {"$sum": 1}}}, {"$match": {"count": {"$gte": 4}}}, {"$sort": {"_id": 1}}])
Find the role, street, city and state of the professionals living in a city that contains the substring 'West'.
db.Professionals.find({"city": {"$regex": "West"}}, {"_id": 0, "role_code": 1, "street": 1, "city": 1, "state": 1})
What is the average bike availablility for stations not in Palo Alto?

db.status.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "station", "localField": "station_id", "foreignField": "id", "as": "st"}}, {"$unwind": "$st"}, {"$match": {"st.city": {"$ne": "Palo Alto"}}}, {"$group": {"_id": None, "avg_bikes": {"$avg": "$bikes_available"}}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "avg_bikes": 1}}])
What are the start station's name and id for the one that had the most start trips in August?

db.trip.aggregate([{"$match": {"start_date": {"$regex": "^8/"}}}, {"$group": {"_id": "$start_station_name", "count": {"$sum": 1}, "start_station_id": {"$first": "$start_station_id"}}}, {"$sort": {"count": -1}}, {"$limit": 1}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "start_station_name": "$_id", "start_station_id": 1}}])
Which owner owns the most dogs? List the owner id, first name and last name.

db.Dogs.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": "$owner_id", "dog_count": {"$sum": 1}}}, {"$sort": {"dog_count": -1}}, {"$limit": 1}, {"$lookup": {"from": "Owners", "localField": "_id", "foreignField": "owner_id", "as": "o"}}, {"$unwind": "$o"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "owner_id": "$_id", "first_name": "$o.first_name", "last_name": "$o.last_name"}}])
Find the states where both owners and professionals live.

db.Owners.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": None, "owner_states": {"$addToSet": "$state"}}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "Professionals", "pipeline": [{"$group": {"_id": None, "prof_states": {"$addToSet": "$state"}}}], "as": "p"}}, {"$unwind": "$p"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "states": {"$setIntersection": ["$owner_states", "$p.prof_states"]}}}, {"$unwind": "$states"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "state": "$states"}}, {"$sort": {"state": 1}}])
List the names of all concerts.
db.concert.find({}, {"_id": 0, "concert_Name": 1})
A list of the top 5 countries by number of invoices. List country name and number of invoices.

db.invoices.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": "$billing_country", "invoice_count": {"$sum": 1}}}, {"$sort": {"invoice_count": -1}}, {"$limit": 5}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "billing_country": "$_id", "invoice_count": 1}}])
What is the campus fee of "San Jose State University" in year 1996?

db.Campuses.aggregate([{"$match": {"Campus": "San Jose State University"}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "csu_fees", "localField": "Id", "foreignField": "Campus", "as": "f"}}, {"$unwind": "$f"}, {"$match": {"f.Year": 1996}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "CampusFee": "$f.CampusFee"}}])
What is the area of the appelation that produces the highest number of wines before the year of 2010?

db.wine.aggregate([{"$match": {"Year": {"$lt": 2010}}}, {"$group": {"_id": "$Appelation", "count": {"$sum": 1}}}, {"$sort": {"count": -1}}, {"$limit": 1}, {"$lookup": {"from": "appellations", "localField": "_id", "foreignField": "Appelation", "as": "a"}}, {"$unwind": "$a"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "Area": "$a.Area"}}])
How many trips started from Mountain View city and ended at Palo Alto city?

db.trip.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "station", "localField": "start_station_id", "foreignField": "id", "as": "start_station"}}, {"$unwind": "$start_station"}, {"$lookup": {"from": "station", "localField": "end_station_id", "foreignField": "id", "as": "end_station"}}, {"$unwind": "$end_station"}, {"$match": {"start_station.city": "Mountain View", "end_station.city": "Palo Alto"}}, {"$count": "count"}])
Find the first name and last name of the instructor of course that has course name

db.Course.aggregate([{"$match": {"CName": "COMPUTER LITERACY"}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "Faculty", "localField": "Instructor", "foreignField": "FacID", "as": "f"}}, {"$unwind": "$f"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "Fname": "$f.Fname", "Lname": "$f.Lname"}}])
What is the course title of the prerequisite of course Mobile Computing?

db.prereq.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "course", "localField": "course_id", "foreignField": "course_id", "as": "c"}}, {"$unwind": "$c"}, {"$match": {"c.title": "Mobile Computing"}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "course", "localField": "prereq_id", "foreignField": "course_id", "as": "pc"}}, {"$unwind": "$pc"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "title": "$pc.title"}}])
What is the last name of the professor whose office is located in DRE 102, and when were they hired?

db.EMPLOYEE.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "PROFESSOR", "localField": "EMP_NUM", "foreignField": "EMP_NUM", "as": "p"}}, {"$unwind": "$p"}, {"$match": {"p.PROF_OFFICE": "DRE 102"}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "EMP_LNAME": 1, "EMP_HIREDATE": 1}}])
How many people live in Gelderland district?
db.city.aggregate([{"$match": {"District": "Gelderland"}}, {"$group": {"_id": None, "total_population": {"$sum": "$Population"}}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "total_population": 1}}])
Display all the information about the department Marketing.
db.departments.find({"DEPARTMENT_NAME": "Marketing"}, {"_id": 0})
What are the average fastest lap speed in races held after 2004 grouped by race name and ordered by year?

db.races.aggregate([{"$match": {"year": {"$gt": 2014}}}, {"$lookup": {"from": "results", "localField": "raceId", "foreignField": "raceId", "as": "r"}}, {"$unwind": "$r"}, {"$addFields": {"speedNum": {"$convert": {"input": "$r.fastestLapSpeed", "to": "double", "onError": None, "onNull": None}}}}, {"$match": {"speedNum": {"$ne": None}}}, {"$group": {"_id": "$name", "avg_speed": {"$avg": "$speedNum"}, "year": {"$first": "$year"}}}, {"$sort": {"year": 1}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "avg_speed": 1, "name": "$_id", "year": 1}}])
Which model has the most version(make) of cars?
db.car_names.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": "$Model", "count": {"$sum": 1}}}, {"$sort": {"count": -1, "_id": 1}}, {"$limit": 1}])
Can you return all detailed info of jobs which was done by any of the employees who is presently earning a salary on and above 12000?

db.job_history.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "employees", "localField": "EMPLOYEE_ID", "foreignField": "EMPLOYEE_ID", "as": "emp"}}, {"$unwind": "$emp"}, {"$match": {"emp.SALARY": {"$gte": 12000}}}, {"$project": {"_id": 0}}])
What are the first names, office locations, and departments of all instructors, and also what are the descriptions of the courses they teach?

db.CLASS.aggregate([{"$lookup": {"from": "EMPLOYEE", "localField": "PROF_NUM", "foreignField": "EMP_NUM", "as": "e"}}, {"$unwind": "$e"}, {"$lookup": {"from": "COURSE", "localField": "CRS_CODE", "foreignField": "CRS_CODE", "as": "c"}}, {"$unwind": "$c"}, {"$lookup": {"from": "PROFESSOR", "localField": "e.EMP_NUM", "foreignField": "EMP_NUM", "as": "p"}}, {"$unwind": "$p"}, {"$lookup": {"from": "DEPARTMENT", "localField": "p.DEPT_CODE", "foreignField": "DEPT_CODE", "as": "d"}}, {"$unwind": "$d"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "EMP_FNAME": "$e.EMP_FNAME", "PROF_OFFICE": "$p.PROF_OFFICE", "CRS_DESCRIPTION": "$c.CRS_DESCRIPTION", "DEPT_NAME": "$d.DEPT_NAME"}}])
How many professors teach a class with the code ACCT-211?
db.CLASS.aggregate([{"$match": {"CRS_CODE": "ACCT-211"}}, {"$group": {"_id": "$PROF_NUM"}}, {"$count": "professor_count"}])
What are the names of circuits that belong to UK or Malaysia?
db.circuits.find({"country": {"$in": ["UK", "Malaysia"]}}, {"_id": 0, "name": 1})
What are the full names of employees who with in department 70 or 90?
db.employees.find({"$or": [{"DEPARTMENT_ID": 70}, {"DEPARTMENT_ID": 90}]}, {"_id": 0, "FIRST_NAME": 1, "LAST_NAME": 1})
What is the name of the high schooler who has the greatest number of likes?

db.Likes.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": "$student_id", "like_count": {"$sum": 1}}}, {"$sort": {"like_count": -1, "_id": 1}}, {"$limit": 1}, {"$lookup": {"from": "Highschooler", "localField": "_id", "foreignField": "ID", "as": "hs"}}, {"$unwind": "$hs"}, {"$project": {"_id": 0, "name": "$hs.name"}}])
List the 5 oldest students, oldest first, with their ages.
db.Student.find({}, {"_id": 0, "Fname": 1, "Age": 1}).sort({"Age": -1}).limit(5)
